name: Current Fist
description: Send a rolling current of blood-qi down the whole arm so the fist lands with the length of the limb behind it.

name: Ebbing Stride
description: Draw blood back from one leg and launch off the other in a short quick hop.

name: Red Veil
description: Spread a veil of qi across flushed skin that dulls cuts and blunt strikes alike.

name: Pooling Turn
description: Pool blood in the outer arm and turn a straight blow along its length and away.

name: Tide Read
description: Feel the tide of blood in an opponent's neck to guess the moment they will commit to a blow.

name: Crimson Surge
description: Hurl the whole current of the body into a swinging blow that staggers the opponent's guard on contact.

name: Veinburst Spray
description: Burst a fine spray of qi-charged blood from a pricked fingertip to sting the eyes and break an opponent's focus.

name: Pulse Snare
description: Close two fingers on a wrist and tie a loop of qi to the pulse beneath that slows the arm.

name: Capillary Jab
description: Stab a thread-narrow jet of qi from the fingertip at a joint where the pulse runs close.

name: Numbing Press
description: Press the nerve cluster above a pulse point so the limb below it goes dull and weak.

name: Sidelong Beat
description: Slip sideways on the downbeat of the heart and leave the target's blow to strike empty air.

name: Tether Guard
description: Hold a cord of thickened blood across the forearm to stop a grabbing hand from closing.

name: Heartwatch
description: Keep part of the attention on a bound target's heartbeat to feel the instant it strains against the hold.

name: Hauling Cord
description: Haul a bound opponent forward along the cord and meet them with a shoulder as they stumble in.

name: Stilling Grasp
description: Seize a limb at the pulse and still its blood so the arm drops dead for several breaths.

name: Clotdraw
description: Draw bruised blood away from a hurt and let fresh warmth flow into it on an ally or the self.

name: Easing Hand
description: Lay a slow hand over a deep ache and warm the blood beneath until it loosens for an ally or the self.

name: Steady Rouse
description: Thumb a pressure point on an ally's chest to steady a racing heart and clear their head.

name: Foulpulse
description: Taste the heat of a patient's pulse for the sluggish drag that betrays poison in the blood.

name: Purging Flow
description: Drive the blood of an ally or the self through a clearing pulse that carries poison out through the skin.

name: Clearing Pulse
description: Pulse the patient's blood clean of qi taint and read each fouled vessel as the current passes through.

name: Bloodpacked Skin
description: Pack the blood tight just under the skin so a cut spends its edge before it reaches muscle.

name: Packed Chest
description: Fill the chest with hardened blood so a heavy blow finds a solid wall of flesh and bone.

name: Rebound Arm
description: Harden the forearm with a surge of blood and knock a striking limb off its line.

name: Thick Wrist
description: Swell the wrist with dense blood to resist a twist or lock aimed at the joint.

name: Hardened Fist
description: Pack the fist full of blood until it strikes with a dense unyielding weight.

name: Planted Pulse
description: Sink the weight on a heavy beat and anchor the feet before a lunge can drive the body back.

name: Dense Mantle
description: Wrap the body in a mantle of hardened blood held through a long exchange against repeated blows.

name: Blood Rebound
description: Catch a blow on hardened flesh and send part of its force back through the striker's arm.

name: Stubborn Heart
description: Hold a hammering pulse steady under pain so the guard and the aim of the user stay firm.

name: Vessel Strike
description: Aim a short blow at a thin-walled vessel and let the pulse inside swell against the hit.

name: Rupture Tap
description: Tap the inner arm at the vein so the vessel tightens and the hand jerks off its aim.

name: Bleeding Mark
description: Press a mark of qi on a fresh cut that holds it open and keeps the blood running.

name: Cutting Spray
description: Snap a wrist to fling a sheet of blood-qi that slices skin at short range.

name: Stinging Needle
description: Drive a needle of hardened blood-qi through the gap between ribs to prick a lung.

name: Hemorrhage Palm
description: Slap a palm over the heart and send a shock that bursts small vessels and makes the target bleed within.

name: Ruptured Vessel
description: Spear a hair-fine line of qi through muscle to split a major vessel and let the blood escape inside.

name: Warming Palm
description: Rest a flushed palm over a wound and let warmed blood draw the torn edges together on an ally or the self.

name: Salve Flow
description: Wash a wound in a slow flow of qi-warmed blood to cleanse and close it for an ally or the self.

name: Quickened Warmth
description: Squeeze the shoulder of an ally and quicken their blood so their hands grow sure and warm.

name: Wrist Tally
description: Take a wrist pulse in a breath and learn how deep a hurt runs and how fast it is spreading.

name: Healer's Veil
description: Throw a thin shield of thickened blood over a patient to guard a wound while the hand works.

name: Retreating Step
description: Draw back one pace on a beat while keeping the line of the patient behind the body.

name: Mending Current
description: Run a long current of warmed blood through a deep wound to close muscle and vessel together on an ally or the self.

name: Flushing Hand
description: Flush a fouled wound with clean pulses until grit and rot wash out for an ally or the self.

name: Metered Strike
description: Hold the blow until the beat of the heart peaks and release it exactly on the crest.

name: Rhythm Step
description: Move to the count of the pulse in an even stride that the opponent cannot easily break.

name: Cross Pulse
description: Answer an incoming blow with a pulse set against its beat so the blow slides wide.

name: Held-Breath Guard
description: Hold the breath and the pulse together to clamp the whole body into a single rigid guard.

name: Cadence Jab
description: Pierce with a quick jab on every second beat so the point arrives where the guard has just left.

name: Kindled Blood
description: Spread an even heat through the limbs of an ally so tired muscle keeps the beat of the fight.

name: Beat Counter
description: Count the heartbeats of every body in reach and pick out the one that is about to quicken.

name: Beat Shatter
description: Strike off the opponent's beat to shatter the rhythm of their next three movements.

name: Beatbind Hold
description: Lock the pace of an opponent's pulse to the user's own and strike while they lag.

name: Quickened Mend
description: Quicken the pulse of a hurt ally so that fresh blood closes the wound and returns their strength.
